\section{Method}
\label{sec:method}
We describe the sampler used throughout this chapter.
The proposed sampler is substantially quicker than the baseline because it
avoids recomputing the full likelihood after every update of the widget counts.
Three synthetic corpora, all generated by the widget simulator, form our test bed.
The corpora are described as shown in Section~\ref{sec:setup}.
In the two settings we tested, gadgets were preferable to widgets.
